review.posthog_relevance: Adds error classification and user-facing messaging for SSH tunnel failures in warehouse connectivity, potentially improving diagnostics for warehouse ingestion failures.
review.reason: Adds an error category, user-facing message, and library import for SSH tunnel failures. While the backend implementation and connector changes are not shown, the addition of the error classification and user-facing message represents a substantive, bounded improvement to the warehouse ingestion reliability and user diagnostics. No score of 3 is assigned without evidence of broader systemic implementation. No score of 2 is assigned without evidence of complete implementation and tests

observations.behavior: Adds a new CDC error category, SSH_TUNNEL_FAILED, to the shared CDC error enumeration.
